title: Birth, address and arrival in America in 1955
summary: Joe Lyde gives his name, birth in Worcester in 1934, parents in Belfast, and arriving in the US in October 1955.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I'm going to start with just asking you to give you a full name and the date and place of your birth.
Joseph Henry Lide, and I was born in Worcester, England on the 13th of July, 1934.
And what's your legal address now, Joe? I mean, where would you vote if you voted?

I don't have one. I don't have one. I was 21 when I was just before I left to come here, and I'm not a registered voter anywhere, but I guess I can register and vote in the British election when I get back this year.
Are you going back to Worcester?
No, to Northern Ireland. That's where my parents live now.
Now, when you, how long have you been here in this country?
About three and a half years.
